scope: Two selected REST operations; no server, route binder, dispatcher, native object loader or authentication implementation.

element_by_id.success_body: bare serialized object, not internal payload envelope

shared.commit_uuid_binding: declared; commitId unused by both controller bodies
shared.view_capability_error_payload: controller treats as non-success ->404; no401 invented
shared.success_payload_constructors: element/list and correlation id nonnull; HTTP response strips correlation envelope
unmapped: UUID/direction binding errors and exact query parameter resolver
context lookup/dispatch/block timeout or exception mapping
content negotiation and JSON ResponseBodyAdvice runtime wiring
malformed/foreign EObject serialization and getter/proxy failures

object_projection.traversal: getElements omits implied Relationship descendant itself, still visits descendants; an admitted Element root is added before filtering descendants
object_projection.relationship_set: HashSet union of owned and inverse relationships; isImplied filter after union; no stable upstream array order established
object_projection.inverse_adapter_absent: known null adapter yields empty incoming set; unresolved adapter facts are not absence

serialization.root: SysML Element @id from elementId; null throws Optional.of; @type EClass name
serialization.features: all structural features, including transient; Java UTF16 name sort
serialization.attributes: caller-observed JSON or enum literal; explicit null retained
serialization.eannotations: exact Ecore reference identity omitted, not a name heuristic
serialization.single_reference: nonnull nonvirtual Element with nonnull elementId -> {@id}; standard-library flag does not exclude; other nonnull values omitted
serialization.many_reference: list Element items only; omit standard-library, virtual and null-ID targets; non-list produces []

json_adapter.parser: serde_json=1.0.151 arbitrary_precision; original valid JSON text retained for wire emission
json_adapter.numeric_spelling: must not re-emit parsed Value as original because serde normalizes E/e, absent exponent plus and -0
json_adapter.unknown_properties: preserved verbatim in admitted JSON DTO
json_adapter.not_claimed: Jackson byte/key-order or numeric-format parity, complete native getters/EMF serializers
